text:
Renee Holt: Idea: reallocate a small leftover recognition budget to run a one-off 'Community Impact Awards' for employees who volunteered externally this quarter. 6 micro-grants ($75) + shoutouts in All-Hands. Starting thread to confirm process.

Marco Silva: Love this. Timeline? nomination method?

Renee Holt: Nominations open today -> close in 10 days. People can self-nominate or nominate peers. Need short proof of volunteer activity (link/photo or coordinator email).

Aisha Khan: Will these micro-grants be taxable/local-country sensitive? Also budget total?

Renee Holt: Total ~$450. We'll check tax treatment; prefer e-gifts or donation option to charity.

HR-Bot: Form draft: https://forms.gle/communityimpact (fields: nominee, nominator optional, org volunteered with, brief description, proof link, reward preference: e-gift/charity/shoutout-only)

Lydia Park: I can help moderate submissions and create the All-Hands slide. Can we add a short rubric (impact to community, initiative, representation of values)?

Tom Becker: I'll coordinate with Finance once finalists chosen; need payment emails and approvals.

Renee Holt: Action items:
- Renee: update form with rubric + deadline (today)
- Lydia: slide template and shortlist doc
- Tom: ping Finance for final approval once finalists selected
- HR-Bot: reminders 3 days before close and day-of

Marco Silva: Also suggest a small "volunteer spotlight" quote from nominator to include on slide. Good PR for program.

Renee Holt: Great idea. Adding a one-line quote field to the form. Closing thread for now, will post links and calendar invites.
